preparationNotes: Your execution becomes a 3-second holy channel: you stand still and fire a continuous beam at your target, and every beam tick applies your on-hit effects (gear, charms, on-hit damage) — built for high on-hit over attack speed. If the target dies mid-channel, you briefly reacquire before the beam ends.
Mature reachable biome caps; +5 where authored upgrades permit; full owner HP/barrier; production fresh summons; no rites.
Ordered abilities use production triggers. Only declared target-casting Brace replaces its low-HP default.
Historical starting point: package-fit-r1 balanced reference; frame/path changes are new packages, not historical reuses.
Authored flat/on-hit or channel delivery: Deathfang supplies actual on-hit magnitude; Catalyst amplifies it.
Relic relic-equilibrium-shard: modest frequency and potency without signed penalty.
sweep has first offensive priority; multiple delivery opportunities support Sweep.
Offensive stance is always active; no stance switching.
Channel package omits Orbit to avoid unnecessary movement; telegraph escape remains.
Unused RP is deliberate bounded-package headroom, not a claim of optimal allocation.
